overview: The Medford City Council addressed several municipal matters, requesting updates on COVID-19 vaccination planning, legal settlement expenditures, SeeClickFix service tracking, and pre-budget hearings. The Council also passed resolutions urging state tax relief options, condemning the U.S. Capitol attack, and honoring retiring police officers and community members.

items.title: Pandemic Tax Interest and Penalty Waiver Request
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting state legislation to allow local cities to waive late tax interest and penalties, along with a request for collection data from the City Treasurer.

items.title: Commendation of Retiring Police Officers
items.summary: The Council approved commendations for retiring police officers William Butts and Robert Kelly honoring their three decades of service.

items.title: Tax Deadline Discount Program Discussion
items.summary: The Council voted to table a resolution regarding an advance payment discount for property taxes until February 2.

items.title: FY2022 Pre-Budget Department Head Hearings
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution to schedule pre-budget hearings with department heads beginning in February to review department goals and fiscal needs.

items.title: SeeClickFix System Update and Review
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting an update on recent modifications to the SeeClickFix ticket management system and scheduling a Committee of the Whole review.

items.title: Republic Parking Financial Update and Hearing
items.summary: The Council approved scheduling a Committee of the Whole meeting with Republic Parking to receive a financial report and answer enforcement questions.

items.title: Resolution Condemning the U.S. Capitol Insurrection
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution condemning the January 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol and affirming support for the peaceful transition of power.

items.title: COVID-19 Mass Vaccination Site Update
items.summary: The Council approved a request for a written update regarding local COVID-19 mass vaccination site planning, amending it to express concerns to the federal delegation over vaccine distribution delays.

items.title: Itemized Legal Expenditure and Settlement Accounting
items.summary: The Council approved a request for an itemized accounting of municipal legal expense accounts and documentation for legal judgments and voluntary settlements made since January 2020.

items.title: Condolences on the Passing of Eugene McGillicuddy
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution offering condolences to the family of community volunteer Eugene McGillicuddy.

items.title: Recognition of Karen Rose
items.summary: The Council approved a commendation for former Health and Elder Affairs Director Karen Rose following her election as Vice President of the Board of Directors for Mystic Valley Elder Services.

items.title: Committee Report on Zoning Recodification
items.summary: The Council accepted a Committee of the Whole report regarding ongoing work with a consultant on zoning recodification.
